_comment_rewrites: PostHog, proxied through our own origin so content blockers do not answer 204 for it. (.*) and not :path* on purpose: :path* does not match a trailing slash, and every PostHog capture endpoint has one (/e/, /flags/, /decide/). With :path* the library loaded and then silently failed to send anything, because /ingest/e/ 404d while /ingest/e answered 400. Static rule first: it is the only one that goes to the assets host.
